body:
AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#355 @ 902c64a64156255ce9ce54147db896ac2142a954 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

Agent 120, job AUD-OPUS-P12-120 (Opus lens, first full review). Tier: T4 (client names and emails in the assign roster, idempotent creates, unassign removes client workouts). Size 1,716, under the grandfathered 3,000 ceiling. CI at this head: Typecheck, lint, test success; CodeQL success. The branch is BEHIND main but merges cleanly, with no overlapping files.

A/B/C = 0/3/1

**B-355-1 — `eas.json:58-59` switches Programs and autosave on in the clinic profile before the backend can serve them.**
Counterexample (two layers):
1. The production backend has FEATURE_MWB_TEMPLATES, FEATURE_MWB_AUTOSAVE_UNDO, FEATURE_NAMED_REGIMES and MWB_AUTOSAVE_LOCK_TOKEN_SECRET unset (backend `.github/fly-env-desired-state.json:36-43`; line 96 says the mobile autosave flag "flips with it"). The autosave route therefore answers 404. `src/hooks/useAutosave.ts:984-1000` treats that as a hard 4xx and sets status 'offline', so the pill shows "Offline — saved on device, will sync" (`AutosaveStatusPill.tsx:11`). It never syncs. The refused variant added in this PR covers 403 only.
2. Even with the backend flags on, the autosave bootstrap cannot complete. The builder sends a placeholder token and relies on the first 409 `autosave_lock_stale` to return `head_revision_index` and `lock_token`. The backend's global HttpExceptionFilter (`main.ts:118`) drops both fields. Production f48267f9 sends only `{"statusCode":409,"message":"Conflict Exception","error":"autosave_lock_stale","timestamp":…,"path":…}` (backend probe https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37343254265). Main ee55f814 sends the same body (https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37343228885): the error-details allowlist has no autosave codes, and the autosave 409 sets no `code`. In the app, AutosaveConflictSchema rejects that body, `conflict` stays undefined, and the hook ends the first edit of every session in a manual 'conflict' state (mobile probe P355-B, https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37343148250). No autosave ever lands, so Undo never enables. Every backend spec reads `exception.getResponse()` directly, so this path was never tested end to end.
Fix rule: remove both clinic flips from this PR. Flip them in a separate PR only after a backend change has shipped that (a) carries `head_revision_index` and `lock_token` in the HTTP body of `autosave_lock_stale`, `autosave_conflict_retry` and `undo_head_moved`, tested through HttpExceptionFilter, and (b) turns on the backend flags and secret (MERGE_DEPENDENCY_GUIDE rule 5).

**B-355-2 — `src/utils/programErrors.ts:37-43` treats the in-flight idempotent retry as a definite refusal.**
Counterexample: when a same-key retry arrives while the first request is still running, withIdempotency (backend `workout-builder.service.ts:232,239`, used by `program-library.service.ts`) answers 409 `{"message":"Request in progress — retry in a moment","error":"Conflict"}` with no code. `isOutcomeUnknown` returns false for it (probe P355-A, run 37343148250: Expected true, Received false). The coach then sees "Could not create the program: Request in progress — retry in a moment. If this keeps happening, contact support and quote reference 3F6C2A1E." `KNOWN.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` (:155) never matches, because the backend sends no such code. The consumer in #357 (`ProgramFormScreen.tsx:234-241`) discards the key and body after a definite answer, so the next tap sends a fresh key and creates a second program once the first one finishes.
Fix rule: treat a 409 with no known program code (the in-flight envelope) as outcome-unknown. Keep the key and body for the retry, show the IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT "still finishing" copy, and test with the exact backend envelope.

**B-355-3 — `src/api/programsApi.ts:320-342` returns only the newest 20 active clients.**
Counterexample: GET /coach/clients returns at most `take` rows (default 20, max 50), newest first, as a bare array paged by `cursor` (backend `coach.controller.ts:63-74`, `coach.service.ts:133-157`). `assignableClients` makes one call with no cursor or take, then sorts by name. A coach with 25 active clients therefore sees 20 of them in the bulk-assign picker, with nothing to say the list is incomplete (probe P355-C, https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37344236942: "20 of 25 clients"). A body that is not an array also returns `[]` with no error (:323).
Fix rule: page with take=50 and cursor set to the last id until a short page arrives, under a bounded page cap. If the cap is hit, a page fails or a body is not an array, fail closed and show that the full client list could not be loaded. Test with 21 and 51 clients.

Follow-ups (C):
- C-355-1 `programErrors.ts:46-49`: the programs_unavailable copy says "Your existing templates still work", but #358 (`CoachNavigator.tsx:601`) replaces the templates route when the flag is on. Fix rule: state only what is true, for example "Programs are not switched on for this account yet. Contact support if you expected to see Programs."

Verified sound: the programsApi routes and DTOs match program-library.controller and its DTOs (52 weeks, 7 days, 50 clients per chunk); every write carries an Idempotency-Key; the display_name mapping matches main; Sentry extras carry codes only.
Probes ran on audit/AUD-OPUS-P12-120/* lane branches cut from this exact head, with probe specs only (never merged). Run 37343980643 was a probe syntax error and is superseded by 37344236942. Approvals on #328 do not carry over to this piece.
